newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: GRP sets up Singapore joint venture.
newsitem.headline: GRP sets up Singapore joint venture.

text.p: Singapore's GRP Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to set up a joint venture company in Singapore to manufacture and market its plastic products.
It said in a statement the other parties to the agreement, Yew Lee Plastic Mould Pte Ltd and Wong Keng Chong, would provide technical assistance to the new company, which was not named.
The initial issued and paid-up capital of the joint venture company would be S$100,000, the statement said. GRP would hold 70 percent of the stock and Wong 30 percent.
It said GRP's investment would be funded internally and that the joint venture was expected to have a positive effect on its earnings and net tangible assets per share for the current financial year.
